test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating Text custom field values across OKR views
test.description:
This test verifies updating Text custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Text custom field values
* Updating short and long text values
* Updating text values containing numbers and special characters
* Correct inline editing behavior across supported views

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

* Text custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Text fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values

steps.data: boxName: TC-6147 SPM - OKR - Updating Text custom field values across OKR views
steps.result:
Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1

Text custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "QA test"
* Objective - ""Q2 strategic initiative #2026 - revenue growth & customer expansion""
* Key Result - "Sprint 25 OKR"

steps.action: Navigate to the Key result Text custom field and update the value
steps.result: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Key result row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Text field is visible with correct value.

steps.action: Navigate to the Key result Text custom field and update the value
steps.result: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
